name: brainpulses
description: BrainPulses v2.0 - API, Admin, Participant, and legacy participant.

scripts.// workspace: Install and run packages from the repo root. Production VPS uses api + admin + participant (see docs/ops/DEPLOY.md).
scripts.cleaninstall: npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix admin && npm ci --prefix participant
scripts.cleaninstall:deploy: npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix admin && npm ci --prefix participant
scripts.audit:all: npm audit --prefix api && npm audit --prefix admin && npm audit --prefix participant && npm audit --prefix participant
scripts.install: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix participant
scripts.install:deploy: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix participant
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin,participant -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:participant"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:admin && npm run build:participant
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:api && npm run build:admin && npm run build:participant
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:participant
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:admin && npm run typecheck:participant
scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:admin && npm run format:participant
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:api && npm run format:check:admin && npm run format:check:participant
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:admin && npm run test:participant
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:admin && npm run test:admin && npm run check:participant && npm run test:participant
scripts.tailwindcss:upgrade: npm run tailwindcss:upgrade:admin && npm run tailwindcss:upgrade:participant
scripts.check:api: npm run check --prefix api && npm run test:api
